evidenceBasis: Owner screenshots from Travelpayouts Earthrightnow project showing Generate links controls.
rule: A Generate links control confirms account-side link generation is available. It does not authorize automatic public placement; ERN still requires utility review, exact-link verification and disclosure.

nextBest.why: Global eSIM utility; low-maintenance if country coverage and exact tracked link are verified.
Strong city-arrival/departure utility for walkable cities and transport hubs.
Airport/resort transfer utility where exact route coverage exists.
Useful in islands and independent-driving destinations if destination coverage is confirmed.
Broad car-rental candidate for road-trip destinations; use only as one selected rental option.
Flight-planning layer for remote destinations; never a camera-ranking driver.
Strong Asia activities/transport complement where inventory materially differs from existing partners.
City-pass utility for supported major cities.

researchProgress.radical-storage: City-arrival utility mapped to six high-traffic ERN city contexts; exact city links remain owner-gated.
researchProgress.localrent: Independent-driving utility mapped to Georgia, Montenegro, Greek islands and Türkiye contexts; exact inventory remains owner-gated.
researchProgress.wegotrip: Self-guided culture utility mapped to Rome, Dublin, Istanbul and Darmstadt contexts; exact destination inventory remains owner-gated.
researchProgress.economybookings: Mapped as car-rental reserve only; activate only where primary rental partners lack useful exact coverage.
researchProgress.getrentacar: Mapped as road-trip reserve only; exact destination coverage and owner link remain required.
researchProgress.saily: Mapped as eSIM fallback; one-connectivity-option rule remains in force.
researchProgress.yesim: Mapped as eSIM fallback for owner-side coverage comparison; not an automatic replacement for Airalo.
researchProgress.gigsky: Mapped as specialized connectivity reserve; no public placement without differentiated coverage.
researchProgress.drimsim: Mapped as specialized connectivity reserve; no public placement without differentiated coverage.
